name: Hollis Marrow
description: A veteran Warden-trained guard. Plants heavy legs, takes the hits meant for you, wards the lance from his Tome of Wards, and answers with a holy-iron blade.

name: Sera Vell
description: A border scout who never stops moving. Hangs back, salvos from range, calls lightning from her Tome of Storms, and darts in with a Talon when a target falters.
